'''June 2001 Phoenix tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in The Outer Rim, Phoenix, AZ on 1 June 2001. [[DJ Andrews]] won it. It is known from Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2415">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-06-viper-meets-tatooine-phoenix-6-1-01d2415/ viper-meets-tatooine-phoenix-6-1-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 6 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-06-viper-meets-tatooine-phoenix-6-1-01d2415/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 1 June 2001
* '''Site:''' The Outer Rim, Phoenix, AZ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[DJ Andrews]]
